if (block is self.entry
                and self.entry is not analyzer.cfg.entry_block):
            return True
        # [R65-diag4 n3 cfg-entry-value-diamond exemption] Same-level structural
        # identity inside the region-reduction algorithm: a chained-compare IfRegion
        # whose entry is also the CFG entry block is STILL a ternary condition header
        # when the last chained-compare block opens a real value diamond -- both of its
        # edges lead to single-expression value blocks (the true path possibly through a
        # pure JUMP_FORWARD connector), i.e. `target = A if lo < x <= hi else B` sitting
        # as the first statement of a code object.  R24-A excluded the CFG entry block
        # only because the diamond could not be told apart from a plain statement if at
        # that point; the diamond itself is the discriminator, so the exclusion is
        # narrowed by structure, not by name/offset/file.
        # 识别条件：block is self.entry and self.entry is cfg.entry_block and
        #   len(chained_compare_ops) >= 2 and 最后一个链式比较块的两条边都是
        #   _is_single_expression_block 的值块（真值路径可经纯 JUMP_FORWARD 连接块）。
        # 归约方式：该链式比较 IfRegion 让出 entry 归属，改由 Phase-2 的
        #   _detect_ternary_pattern 构造 TernaryRegion(condition_block=entry,
        #   true_value_block / false_value_block = 上述两值块, merge_block = 两值块共同
        #   后继)；钻石归约后条件块与值块不再被 IfRegion 语句级占走（原则 2 唯一归属，
        #   原则 3 只有真正的嵌套语句才是抽象节点）。
        # AST 映射：Assign(target=<merge 的 STORE 目标>, value=IfExp(test=chained compare,
        #   body=true 值块表达式, orelse=false 值块表达式)) —— 而不是
        #   `if lo < x <= hi: A else: B` 两条被丢弃返回值的表达式语句
        #   （后者丢掉 STORE_*，即官方尺的 UNDER 1/UNDER 2）。
        _r65_cc_ops = getattr(self, 'chained_compare_ops', None) or []
        if (block is self.entry
                and self.entry is analyzer.cfg.entry_block
                and len(_r65_cc_ops) >= 2
                and self.chained_compare_blocks):
            _r65_cc_last = list(self.chained_compare_blocks)[-1]
            _r65_cc_li = _r65_cc_last.get_last_instruction()
            _r65_cc_succs = sorted(_r65_cc_last.conditional_successors,
                                   key=lambda s: s.start_offset)
            if (_r65_cc_li is not None
                    and _r65_cc_li.opname in FORWARD_CONDITIONAL_JUMP_OPS
                    and len(_r65_cc_succs) == 2):
                _r65_tv = next((s for s in _r65_cc_succs
                                if s.start_offset != _r65_cc_li.argval), None)
                _r65_fv = next((s for s in _r65_cc_succs
                                if s.start_offset == _r65_cc_li.argval), None)
                if _r65_tv is not None and _r65_fv is not None:
                    _r65_eff = [i for i in _r65_tv.instructions
                                if i.opname not in ('NOP', 'CACHE', 'EXTENDED_ARG', 'RESUME')]
                    if (len(_r65_eff) == 1
                            and _r65_eff[0].opname == 'JUMP_FORWARD'
                            and _r65_eff[0].argval is not None):
                        _r65_hop = analyzer.cfg.get_block_by_offset(_r65_eff[0].argval)
                        if _r65_hop is not None:
                            _r65_tv = _r65_hop
                    if (analyzer._is_single_expression_block(_r65_tv)
                            and analyzer._is_single_expression_block(_r65_fv)):
                        return True
        return False
